home.title: Welcome to Postloom
home.intro: Send beautiful, personal emails to a list of people - from your own email account, with checks before anything is sent.

placeholder.body: This part of Postloom is being built. It will be ready in a later version.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Reusable emails you can send again and again.
templates.nameMissing: Give your template a name first.
templates.emptyBody: A template is an email you can reuse. Make one and Postloom fills in each person's details for you.
templates.subject: Subject
templates.usesFields: Details it uses from your list

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.validationFailed: Some information is missing or not valid.
errors.templateInvalid: This template couldn't be read. Check it for typing mistakes.
errors.emailAuthFailed: Your email provider didn't accept the password. Many providers, like Gmail, need an "app password" for apps like Postloom.
errors.emailConnectionFailed: Postloom couldn't reach your email provider. Check your internet connection and the server details.
errors.emailSendFailed: The email couldn't be sent. Please try again later.
errors.headerLineBreak: A subject, name or email address contains a line break. Remove it and try again.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find that. It may have been deleted.
errors.inUse: This is still being used, so it can't be removed yet.
errors.databaseDamaged: Postloom couldn't read its saved information.
errors.databaseUpgradeFailed: Postloom couldn't update its saved information. Nothing was lost, and a backup was kept.
errors.screenTitle: Something went wrong on this screen
errors.screenBody: Your saved work is safe. Try again, and if it keeps happening, use Help → Export diagnostics.

settings.intro: Make Postloom look and behave the way you like.
settings.confirmBeforeSendHint: Shows a summary of who gets what, with 10 seconds to change your mind.
